title: changelog: the 19.0.0-next.1 formula currency-verdict entry says the optional spellings of an amount moved from number, but a bare optional never typed as a number
body:
repo:objectstack#8 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSAaBEfQpU2yJexSJ8

Filing gate: ① (release-fixed wrong text, the 先测可达性 exception: the text is in published CHANGELOGs) · Source: fleet — rider N3 of #35815, found by its developer on PR #38108 and kept out of that code PR because AGENTS.md (Documentation Guardrails) asks a factual error in a released entry to be amended in a dedicated docs-only PR.

## What is wrong

The #35631 entry says the indexed and optional spellings of an amount (`record['amount'] * 0.1`, `record.?amount * 0.1`, `record[?'amount'] * 0.1`) moved from `number` to `{}`. Measured on PR #38108 (ablation of the `readsOnlyPlainFields` guard): the two bare optional spellings answer `{}` with and without the guard — an optional is never typed as a number — so they never moved. The spellings that do discriminate read through `orValue` (`record.?amount.orValue(0) * 0.1`).

Where the sentence is (read on origin/main 815e882b): the consumed `.changeset/pre/35631-formula-currency-verdict.md`, and the `19.0.0-next.1` sections of `packages/formula/CHANGELOG.md`, `ui/packages/app-shell/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Proposed text (the developer's, from PR #38108 Acceptance notes)

"the indexed spelling of an amount (`record['amount'] * 0.1`) and the optional spellings read through `orValue` (`record.?amount.orValue(0) * 0.1`); a bare optional (`record.?amount * 0.1`) never typed as a number and answered `{}` before and after"

## Business reason

An author or agent reading the release notes is told a spelling changed behaviour that did not; it is the record an upgrade is judged by.

## Reader who acts

Seat `repo:objectstack#8`, one docs-only PR after PR #38108 lands (the corrected test comment is in that PR).

## Dedupe

`is:issue 35631 changelog optional amount` → 2 hits (#35815 open, the parent; #35631 closed, the original card); `is:issue "orValue" formula changelog` → 3 hits, none on this sentence.

Grade: area:data · Task · p3 · reach: readers of the 19.0.0-next.1 release notes; text only, no behaviour.
